title: Badminton — multiple Indian "firsts" this fortnight
summary: Tanvi Sharma (17) wins maiden BWF title — Taipei Open 2026; youngest-ever Taipei Open champion; **first Indian woman to win a BWF World Tour singles title since Saina Nehwal (2008)**...

items: Tanvi Sharma (17) wins maiden BWF title — Taipei Open 2026; youngest-ever Taipei Open champion; **first Indian woman to win a BWF World Tour singles title since Saina Nehwal (2008)**
Ashmita Chaliha wins maiden BWF title — Korea Masters 2026; 4th Indian woman with a BWF Super 300+ singles title in 2026
BWF Badminton World Championships (30th edition) — Indira Gandhi Arena, New Delhi — **India's first hosting since 2009**; mascot: Peacko

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Tanvi Sharma's "first since Saina Nehwal 2008" + India hosting BWF Worlds for the 1st time since 2009 — two distinct badminton "firsts," easy to conflate.
